note: PCCM Beta-PERT with lambda=4 is ONE-DIMENSIONAL: alpha=1+4r, beta=5-4r, alpha+beta=6. Nothing outside this line can arise from a PCCM driver.
table_note: Table shapes are a stated subset: the tails (r=0, r=1) are where a uniform node grid fails, plus interior points to show the error is not an artefact of the extremes.
